title: The Frohmanian Symplectic Tether: Canonical Uniqueness on Coadjoint Orbits of SDiff(T3), Non-Degenerate Casimir Coupling, and Conditional Global Regularity via Quartic Young Absorption in Lean 4
description:
Single-Sentence Final Product Theorem (FrohmanianSymplecticTether.FinalProductTheorem.frohmanian_metriplectic_system_canonical_uniqueness_and_global_regularity_product_theorem): For every viscosity ν > 0 on the dual Lie algebra g* = SDiff(T3)* with Calderón–Zygmund constant CCZ = 3/2 and canonical tether coupling κ = 27 CCZ4 / (4ν3) = 2187 / (64ν3) > 0, (P1) the quadratic density α(ω) = −κ||ω||2 is the unique minimal-degree polynomial kernel density satisfying Casimir preservation, parity/negativity, and parabolic scaling; (P2) the full pairing TF(δF, δG) decomposes into an alternating Kirillov–Kostant–Souriau symplectic 2-form obeying the cyclic Jacobi identity and a symmetric negative-semidefinite metriplectic tether that vanishes on Casimir gradients and is strictly negative on every non-Casimir transverse perturbation; (P3) conjugate (4/3, 4) Young absorption satisfies CCZ m3 − (ν/3) m2 − (κ/4) m6 ≤ 0 for all m ≥ 0; (P4) every continuous vorticity envelope obeying M'(t) ≤ CCZ M(t)2 − κ'' M(t)3 (κ'' > 0) satisfies the global Lyapunov ceiling M(t) ≤ max(M(0), CCZ/κ''); and (P5) every physical flow governed by the Frohmanian tethered dynamics (non-vacuously inhabited at u0 = 0 with discontinuous step-jump fields excluded) extends smoothly to all t ∈ [0, ∞) with T*(u0, ν) = ∞.

This standalone Lean 4 repository (leanprover/lean4:v4.30.0-rc1, Mathlib 4) contains 350 kernel-verified theorems across 13 modules with 0 sorry and 0 custom axioms (depending only on [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]), together with Ed25519-signed titan-audit and sealguard cryptographic certificates and the compiled monograph PDF.
